doc: TREES-LP-a: Kenney Nature Kit (.dae) material -> palette key. keys = palette key -> the sRGB diffuse colour of the Kenney material it stands for (the kit exports odd diffuse values, e.g. leafsGreen = 41,201,171, so these are the file's values, not natural colours); tools/dae-import.mjs picks the nearest by CIE Lab. maxDelta = Lab distance above which a colour is reported as unmapped. byName overrides by material name. trunk = keys whose triangles shape the tree collision prism. scale = importer scale (Kenney trees are 1.2-1.7 m, the game's trees ~8-10 m).
